page_title: KIAgent — your whole digital life, back in your hands

summary.name: KIAgent
summary.one_liner: KIAgent is a free, open-source personal AI app that gathers your email, chats, meetings and files on your own computer and writes daily and pre-meeting briefs from them.
use_cases: Start the day with a summary of what needs attention
Prepare for meetings with a brief of open items and sources
Search emails, chats and files from any AI tool on your computer
Track commitments and follow-ups you owe people
Keep a private local index of personal and work documents
summary.what_it_does: KIAgent connects to email, chat apps, calendars, cloud drives and local folders, then sorts, files and indexes that content on your own computer. It writes a morning brief and a brief a few minutes before each meeting, listing what matters, what you owe, and links to the source of each point. Briefs and meeting summaries are written using your ChatGPT plan or a local model on your Mac or PC. Other AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Codex and VS Code can query your data through an open standard, and a log shows each access, which you can revoke.
notable: Briefs written on your existing ChatGPT plan (no API key) or a local model
Open source under MIT license with a local index and no telemetry
Every AI access is recorded and can be revoked in one click
Optional paid Remote tier to reach your machine from a phone or the web
caveats: Optional Remote tier costs $5/month; the local app itself is free
Queries sent to an AI tool do travel to that AI, and ChatGPT-processed content is handled by OpenAI under your account
More connectors are promised over time; some sources may not be supported yet
